title.narrative: Provision of Home Care Service for Elderly in Tirana

description.narrative: Promoting social inclusion in the Municipality of Tirana for the elderly groups. The project will establish a model of multidisciplinary home care service for the elderly in Tirana Municipality, aiming to be a pioneer service at the country level; and will increase the awareness of elderly, professionals in the field of care and the general public on promoting a healthy active aging and autonomous life in old age.
